name: Adcp Client
description: Adds the /adcp skill for calling AdCP advertising agent tools over MCP or A2A, running protocol compliance scenarios, and querying the AdCP registry. Includes built-in test agents for zero-config use.
longDescription:
Ships **22 skills** and **29 agents**.

- **Skills** (22): `adcp` (Interact with AdCP (Ad Context Protocol) advertising agents over MCP or A2A protocols), `adcp-brand` (Execute AdCP Brand Protocol operations with brand agents - get brand identity data, search for licensable rights, acquire…), `adcp-creative` (Execute AdCP Creative Protocol operations with creative agents - build creatives from briefs or existing assets, preview renderings,…), `adcp-governance` (Execute AdCP Governance Protocol operations with governance agents - manage property lists, collection lists, content standards, and campaign…), `adcp-media-buy` (Execute AdCP Media Buy Protocol operations with sales agents - discover advertising products, create and manage campaigns, sync…), `adcp-si` (Execute AdCP Sponsored Intelligence (SI) Protocol operations with brand agents - start conversational sessions, send messages, preview offerings,…), `adcp-signals` (Execute AdCP Signals Protocol operations with signal agents - discover audience signals using natural language and activate them…), `build-brand-rights-agent` (Use when building an AdCP brand rights agent — a platform that represents brand identity, licenses rights (image…), and 14 more
- **Agents** (29): `ad-creative-expert` (Expert at building effective ads across social, web, CTV, and other platforms), `ad-tech-protocol-expert-deep` (Expert in OpenRTB, IAB standards, and programmatic advertising protocols), `ad-tech-protocol-expert` (Expert on ad tech protocols (OpenRTB, IAB VAST/VPAID, MRAID, DBCFM, AdCP, TMP)), `adtech-product-expert-deep` (Product manager who is an expert on ad tech and building for both agents and humans), `adtech-product-expert` (Product manager view on ad-tech workflows — DSPs, SSPs, agencies, publishers, measurement vendors), `agentic-product-architect` (Expert in designing agentic tool products - MCP servers, A2A agents, ChatGPT apps, Claude skills), `code-reviewer-deep` (Expert code review specialist for agentic ad tech systems), `code-reviewer` (Reviews code changes for correctness, security, and style), and 21 more

Installs with `claude plugin install adcp-client@claude-community` from `adcontextprotocol/adcp-client`.
